title: SPAN: Benchmarking and Improving Cross-Calendar Temporal Reasoning of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (SPAN) that evaluates LLMs on their ability to reason across different calendar systems, specifically including the Islamic and Hebrew calendars. It also includes a 'Festival-based' reasoning task that tests the models on specific religious holidays such as Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, and Christmas Day.
